opportunities.name: Kayak hotel search with filters and sort
opportunities.description: Search hotels on Kayak for a given destination, dates and guest/room counts, then sort by price low to high (optionally apply amenity filters).
steps: Type destination in the search box and select the matching suggestion
Pick check-in and check-out dates in the calendar
Open rooms/guests selector and increment adults/rooms as needed
Optionally apply filters (free internet, style, amenities)

instances.values: Le Marais, Paris; dates 27-2; extra guests/rooms; sort price low to high
Santa Fe, New Mexico; dates 16-18; guests incremented
Kashi Vishwanath Temple, Varanasi; dates 6-10; guests/rooms; filters free internet, family, A/C; sort price low to high

opportunities.name: Qatar Airways flight search
opportunities.description: Search flights between origin and destination for a departure date, set passengers and cabin class, and show flights then select a fare.
steps: Type origin and select autocomplete option
Type destination and select autocomplete option (if not preset)
Open depart date picker and choose date
Open Passengers/Class and adjust passenger counts and cabin
Choose a flight price heading and click Select fare

instances.values: Colombo to New York; 24 June 2023; Business/First; child +1, infant -1
Doha to Durban; 28 May 2023; infant +1; select fare
